verdict.rationale: Docs confirm FIDO2 support and explicitly market 'passwordless login' to Microsoft/Nextcloud (nitrokey-docs-4), which implies discoverable/resident-key credentials, and FIDO2 is listed as a core feature (nitrokey-docs-1, nitrokey-docs-16). However, no documentation explicitly names 'resident keys' or 'discoverable credentials,' and community reports note the Nitrokey 3 has lagged on FIDO2 feature parity with competitors (many features listed as 'planned'), raising doubt about completeness. Missing for 10: explicit resident-key/discoverable-credential documentation, independent hands-on verification of usernameless sign-in working end-to-end.
